Theme

Civic life: news, government & the law

social class noun

also class (social), lower class, middle class, upper class, working class, rank (in society)

classical

Cic. Dom. 74: proximus est huic dignitātī equester ōrdō (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 179, 180

ōrdō, ōrdinis m.

noun, third declension

a class or order of society

ōrdō senātōrius, the senatorial order; Traupman: ōrdō īnferior, the lower class, ōrdō medius, the middle class, ōrdō superior, the upper class.

Other words

  • equitēs, equitum m. pl. — the knights, the Roman middle class

    noun, third declension, plural · also used · classical · Traupman 179

Examples

  • ōrdō īnferior

    the lower classTraupman 179

  • ōrdō medius

    the middle classTraupman 179

  • ōrdō superior

    the upper classTraupman 180

See also aristocracy, status.
